presented_options.D: ARIES-style WAL with explicit undo and redo records plus a separate dirty-page table checkpoint

presented_options.D: a B-tree keyed by the composite (index_key, row_id); duplicates are naturally ordered by row_id

answers.rationale: SR4 requires SeqScan and IndexScan as distinct types, not as variants of a single ScanKind enum. The spec says 'at least the following physical operators must exist as distinct types: SeqScan, IndexScan, Filter, Project...'
